content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya often struggle to set up reliable online stores due to restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal. COREMERCH provides a sovereign infrastructure solution that enables you to own your digital commerce stack without reliance on external platforms. This guide focuses on using Supabase as your order database, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for accepting crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-what-actually-how-5|Payment Gateways]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-my-unfiltered-take-2|payment]]s and delivering digital products.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often fail in markets where financial isolation is prevalent. COREMERCH's infrastructure, built on decentralized elements, empowers creators to bypass these restrictions. By owning your stack, you mitigate risks associated with reliance on third-party platforms. Supabase serves as a robust order database that ensures your transactions are secure, fast, and under your control, allowing you to focus on your content instead of payment barriers.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the essential tools: a GitHub account for hosting your store, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with Supabase to manage your order database effectively. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload and consider your marketing strategies for promoting your store once live. With these elements in place, you’ll be set for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your backend using GitHub Pages and Apps Script. This setup takes approximately 4-6 hours, following the Sovereign Blueprint. After your backend is ready, configure NOWPayments to process transactions seamlessly. Then, integrate Supabase to manage incoming orders and product data. After setting up your payment processing, test the entire pipeline using test transactions to ensure that payments are verified and products are delivered instantly upon confirmation.
Own your digital store infrastructure, eliminating reliance on traditional payment processors.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the setup is complete, it’s time to go live. Publish your GitHub Pages store and ensure all links are functional. Promote your store through social media and other channels to attract potential customers. When a customer makes their first purchase, your integrated systems will automatically process the payment via NOWPayments. Monitor the transaction to ensure everything functions smoothly, and use this opportunity to refine your customer experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is operational, consider scaling your offerings. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can deploy additional products and enhance your backend capabilities. Keep track of customer feedback and sales data in Supabase to inform your growth strategy. Explore integration with additional services or marketing tools to boost visibility. As your store grows, you’ll have the infrastructure in place to support increased traffic and product offerings.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Supabase provides a powerful order management system that puts you in control.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate Supabase with my digital store?

To integrate Supabase, create a new project within Supabase and set up your database tables for orders and products. Use the Supabase client library in your Apps Script to interact with the database, manage orders, and fetch product details.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers over 300 cryptocurrencies for payment processing with a minimal fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC and allows for immediate payment verification, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
Can I use Cloudflare Pages for my digital store?

Yes, Cloudflare Pages is an excellent option for hosting your digital store. It provides fast performance and security features, making it a viable alternative to GitHub Pages for your infrastructure setup.
What features does the Edge Commerce Stack offer?

The Edge Commerce Stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. It supports five products, is end-to-end tested, and is deployed within 48 hours, allowing you to scale your digital store effectively.
